caption: The drawing depicts two similar ceramic jars placed side by side against a plain, light background. Both jars have a rounded, bulbous shape with a wide mouth and short neck, and appear to be rendered in shades of gray with blue decorative elements. The jar on the left features the inscription "H L 1791" in blue lettering on its front, with three small clusters of dots serving as separators. The jar on the right displays a design of interconnected blue circular motifs, each containing a four-dot pattern and encircled by leafy elements, forming a garland-like band around its upper section. The shading on both jars suggests a smooth, slightly reflective surface, and the overall color palette consists of muted gray tones with blue accents.
title: Stoneware Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
